objective: Establish HolyAgent version and installation facts, the correct dependency-update base branch, and whether state migration is required before updating dependencies.
scope: Read-only investigation of the user-level Pi installation, this repository, open PRs and released versions using gh and package metadata.
Inspect dependency updater documentation and migration status without modifying files or state.
constraints: Use kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding for the delegated Pi run.
Use gh for GitHub release and PR facts. Distinguish published stable npm versions, GitHub releases and unreleased PR heads.
Identify the exact user-level installed source/version/location and the repository main version/location.
Apply AGENTS.md release-branch and dependency-updater rules. Recommend a concrete work-branch start from the actual open owner PR stack and its PR base; do not infer from branch names alone.
Determine whether holyagent migrate --dry-run reports legacy state requiring migration; do not run a real migration.
Do not edit files, switch branches, install updates or write version-control state.
Report in under 400 words with exact versions, refs, paths and commands.

criteria.text: Versions: identify installed HolyAgent source/version/location, repository version, latest published stable version and any later unreleased PR version, with gh or package evidence.
Update plan: identify the documented updater and caret-format checks plus the correct branch start and PR base under the active repository conventions and open stack.
Migration: establish whether migration is needed using read-only evidence and name the safe command if it is.
Scope: make no changes to either checkout, user installation or state.

result:
## Report

**Versions**
- Installed (user-level Pi): HolyAgent loads as a Pi git extension `git:github.com/davidbasilefilho/holyagent@release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events` (registered in `C:\Users\david.basile\.pi\agent\settings.json`), materialized at `C:\Users\david.basile\.pi\agent\git\github.com\davidbasilefilho\holyagent`, commit `765aa8b2`, `package.json` version **0.3.4** — the unreleased head of PR #130.
- Repository checkout: `C:\Users\david.basile\dev\holyagent`, on `main` at `460f9453`, version **0.3.3**.
- Latest published stable: npm `holyagent@0.3.3` (`npm view`); GitHub release `holyagent-0.3.3`, published 2026-11-13T20:23:41Z, not a prerelease.
- Later unreleased version: **0.3.4** on all five open `release/0.3.4/*` branches (verified via `git show origin/<branch>:package.json`).

**Update plan**
- Documented updater: `mise run deps:update` → `bun scripts/update-dependencies.ts` (keeps every pin on the newest stable release line, refreshes `bun.lock`; `--dry-run` prints current→next and writes nothing); `mise run deps:check` fails when a pin is behind. Caret-format enforced by `scripts/dependency-ranges.test.ts` (every range a caret at line boundary or `workspace:*`); pins enforced by `scripts/dependency-pins.test.ts`. AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing pins or `bun.lock`.
- Stack: 5 open owner non-draft PRs (#122–#130), all currently based on `dev` (at `44c79ab2`, `release: 0.3.3 (#121)`); `main` (`460f9453`) is one commit ahead of `dev` via squash #129. Most recently updated is #130 `release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events` (2026-11-14T01:34:03Z, head `765aa8b2`, MERGEABLE) — the open stack's top.
- Recommendation: cut the dependency-update branch from `release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events` (`765aa8b2`) and open its PR with base **`release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events`** (the immediate predecessor the branch starts from, per the stack plan), not `dev`. No repository convention bars this base. Note the `dev`-vs-`main` lag (#129) remains a release-level concern for the 0.3.4 integration, not for this branch's base.

**Migration**
- Not required. `holyagent migrate --dry-run` (run via the installed CLI from the git cache, and in the dev checkout) reports `NothingToMigrate: ... has no .holyclaude/ or .holycodex/ folder with state in it`; no `.holyclaude`/`.holycodex` folder exists under the dev directory or `.pi` (find, maxdepth 4). Safe command if it ever reports work: `holyagent migrate` (real run) after a confirming `--dry-run`.

**Scope**
- Read-only only: `git fetch`/`git show`, `gh` reads, `npm view`, two `migrate --dry-run` runs. No file edits, branch switches, installs, or version-control/state writes.
